put.description:
Update application level sign-in experience for the specified application. Create a new sign-in experience if it does not exist. 
 - Only branding properties and terms links customization is supported for now. 

 - Only third-party applications can be customized for now. 

 - Application level sign-in experience customization is optional, if provided, it will override the default branding and terms links.

layout.description: Dev feature. The sign-in page layout for this application. Omit the property to keep the currently saved layout unchanged; send `null` to reset to the default layout (an application without saved sign-in experience settings effectively uses `null`). Available to every application type; only effective when developer features are enabled (non-null values are rejected with 422 otherwise).

200.description: The application's sign-in experience was successfully updated.

201.description: A new application level sign-in experience settings was successfully created.

422.description: The layout value is not supported (developer features are disabled).

get.summary: Get the application level sign-in experience
get.description:
Get application level sign-in experience for a given application. 
 - Only branding properties and terms links customization is supported for now. 

 - Only third-party applications can have the sign-in experience customization for now.

200.description: Returns the application's application level sign-in experience.

layout.description: Dev feature. The sign-in page layout selected for this application; `null` means the default layout.

404.description: The application does not exist or the application level sign-in experience does not exist.
